subject: Post-demo: Greenfield Health security scoping & SOC2/ISO pathway
messages:
From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@greenfieldhealth.com>

Cc: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up and security questions from today's demo

Hi Priyom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the latency numbers and route-level observability looked promising. A couple of quick security items my team asked me to follow up on so we can kick off the vendor review: 

- Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report? If not, what is the expected timeline to obtain one?
- Is Redwood willing to add Greenfield Health to scope for HIPAA-controlled processing?
- We attached our initial vendor security questionnaire (see attachment) — can you confirm an owner who will return that?

We are also starting to think about long-term certifications (ISO 27001 and potential FedRAMP for our federal pilots). Any guidance on whether Redwood has a FedRAMP path or experience supporting FedRAMP-bound customers would be helpful. 

Attaching: Greenfield_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Alex Barnes
Director, IT Security
Greenfield Health

[Attachment: Greenfield_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@greenfieldhealth.com>, Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up and security questions from today's demo

Alex —

Great to hear from you and thanks for sending the questionnaire. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation for the inference platform (scope: hosted API + control plane). We can share a redacted report and a summary of scoped systems. I attached a short SOC2 summary for your security team.

2) HIPAA: We support PHI processing under a Business Associate Agreement. Scope specifics (e.g., dedicated vs hosted, retention controls) will determine the exact flow — happy to loop in our compliance lead.

3) Questionnaire: Neha (CC'd) will drive our responses to your questionnaire and aims to return a completed version in 5 business days. Monica will handle any artifact collection (attestations, control narratives).

4) Long-term certifications: We are actively exploring ISO 27001 scope expansion for H2 2026 and have a roadmap conversation scheduled for June with our security ops team. We do not currently hold FedRAMP authorization; we have supported partners through preparatory control mapping and can discuss a FedRAMP readiness engagement if that's of interest.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- Neha to review your questionnaire and assign sections (owner: Neha Kapoor) — target 2026-05-28 for first-pass return.
- Redwood to provide redacted SOC2 Type II and a controls summary (attached).
- Schedule a compliance working session (30-45m) between Neha/Monica and your security team next week.

I'll also prepare a one-page mutual action plan that maps artifacts, owners, and timeline.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: RDW_SOC2_Summary_May2026.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks Priyom / Neha —

Quick notes from our side after a short internal review: 
- We appreciate the SOC2 summary — that helps. Our procurement team will still want the redacted report and an inventory of systems in-scope.
- HIPAA BAA will be required for any PHI usage; can you confirm standard draft timelines for signing?
- FedRAMP: not urgent today but the federal pilot team flagged it as "likely" in 2027. Would Redwood be willing to outline a high-level FedRAMP readiness plan? Even a brief slide or checklist would be great.

I've uploaded our questionnaire to a shared location (link below) and added section owners. Short-term ask: can Neha confirm whether the following artifacts are available — control narratives for encryption/key mgmt, network segmentation diagram, and retention/ERASURE procedures?

Shared questionnaire link: https://greenfieldhealth.sharepoint.com/sites/security/rdw-qna

Appreciate the MAP — can we aim to review it during a working session on Friday 2026-05-28? Alex and I are available 09:00-11:30 PT.

Thanks,
Maya Lopez

Greenfield Health
